narrativeProgression.description: Melber asks Penn about the message of his novel.
Penn describes his novel as a "love letter" to the best of America, disguised as a satire on societal trends.
Melber reveals negative reviews of the novel, including calls for Sean Penn to "be stopped" as a novelist.
Penn acknowledges the book's offensiveness and finds humor in the strong reactions.
Melber thanks Penn for appearing on the show.

Penn acknowledges the legal nature of the issue and declines to give a personal opinion.

youtube_description:
In this full interview between actor Sean Penn and Ari Melber, Penn reflects on Donald Trump’s election, saying it proves that in today’s culture, integrity is considered “a fool’s game”. The actor says Americans are losing their grip on reality versus fantasy and rooted for a villain like Trump “against their own interests.” Penn also responds to criticism of his controversial interview with El Chapo and to literary critics who wrote that the Oscar winning actor should “shut his face” after publishing his new dystopian novel.
